badges.name: First Sign
badges.how: Post your first sign.

badges.name: Lookout
badges.how: Be named as a finder on a sign someone else posted.

badges.name: Second Opinion
badges.how: Find a way on someone else’s sign.

badges.name: Cracked It
badges.how: Solve a sign that was posted unsolved.

badges.name: Another Way
badges.how: Write a second, different way on the same sign.

badges.name: Company
badges.how: Another player finds a way on a sign you posted.

badges.name: States
badges.how: Find signs in more states.

badges.name: Mile Markers
badges.how: Find more signs.

badges.name: Home Turf
badges.how: Find 5 signs in one state.

badges.name: Far From Home
badges.how: Find a sign at least 500 miles from your first.

badges.name: Road Trip
badges.how: Find two signs within three days of each other.

badges.name: Times Table
badges.how: Use × in a way.

badges.name: Fair Share
badges.how: Use ÷ in a way.

badges.name: Square Root
badges.how: Use √ in a way.

badges.name: Power Up
badges.how: Use a power, like 2^3, in a way.

badges.name: Exclamation Point
badges.how: Use a factorial, like 4!, in a way.

badges.name: Whole Keypad
badges.how: Use every one of + − × ÷ √ ^ ! at least once, across your ways.

badges.name: Every Number
badges.how: Write a way that uses every number on a sign with at least three.

badges.name: Half Mile
badges.how: Write a way that uses a decimal, or a division that comes to a fraction.

badges.name: Zero Sum
badges.how: Write a way where both sides come to 0.

badges.name: Big Number
badges.how: Write a way where both sides come to 1,000 or more.

badges.name: Four Seasons
badges.how: Find signs in winter, spring, summer and fall, in any years.

badges.name: Still Playing
badges.how: Find a sign a year or more after your first.
